{{Quote|He's had a hand in many other projects over the past eighteen years. The Blight Matrix, the Galactophage, Subjugation Droids&mdash;even the Plasm Resource!|M1-4X|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Blight Matrix''' was an experimental weapons project developed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rebus (Sith Empire)|Rebus]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] was involved in the project.
